title: Slovakian Pork Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring tender pork skewers with a Slovakian twist. Perfect for a quick dinner or outdoor gathering.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt marinade ingredients (see below) and add sliced pork. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread pork, sausage, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with additional yogurt marinade for serving, if desired.
Yogurt Marinade: Mix together 1 cup plain yogurt, 2 tablespoons zesty sauce, 1 tablespoon smoky paprika, and 1 minced garlic clove.
Adjust marinade to taste and add additional ingredients as desired.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
